title: On a width-3 path, one interior has boundary-order half-bandwidth 5 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- On an equal-weight path of bandwidth 3, survivors kept in increasing index have Schur half-bandwidth 5 after an interior of length 3, 4, or 6 is deleted.
- The farthest new entries are `-1/1560`, `-1/1404`, and `-13/92380`. Their original-index spans are 8, 9, and 11. The endpoint row stays equal to the original band row.
- Selected κ is unchanged. This does not measure a truncated Gaussian row.

## Test plan

- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/boundary-order-width3`
